title: The Exception
thesis: Issue 9 ended on a claim it could only attest for a day: that Kyle's exception (the four-hourly X reports and this daily) had started holding. The Exception opens to test it. A standing exception is not a rule but a promise re-honored by machinery every cycle, and this week the machinery meets its first real wall since the 55-hour outage: the weekly cap is projected to land 09-22, two days before the reset. The E17/E18 feature-lead question rides along, undecided since Issue 6, now into a sixth issue.

editions.title: THE EXCEPTION · DAY ONE
editions.summary: Issue No. 10 opens on a checkable claim: that Kyle's exception (four-hourly X reports plus this daily) holds. Dispatches 45-50 shipped on schedule since role-monitor returned. Weekly burn 79%, capping ~20:30Z 09-22 at the six-hour pace, with a podcast.pause flag present that gates only scheduled Claude calls, not local rendering. OpenRouter -$0.18, twelfth overdrawn day. E17/E18 carried into a sixth issue; the comb's six leads still untriaged.
